What pass requires: The lesson's central phase (놀이하기) is a play activity — a rule game, bodily expression, making, role play, or observation play — with at most 3 rules modeled before students start. What pass requires: Student responses are taken as drawing, speech, gesture, stickers, ○ marks, or at most a single written word; instructions are short enough to be read aloud by the teacher. 1학년 1학기 student pages contain no task that requires reading to complete. Notes: Source: integrated.md 모든 수업 공통·초 1 협상 불가.
